note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Event A is a generic fictional event and the consequences are generic fictional objects; no person is drawn and nobody is injured. The two rings are ONLY the supplied grouping: the inner ring holds the consequences supplied as 'Immediate consequence (as supplied)', the outer ring those supplied as 'Subsequent consequence (as supplied) — to be examined', with identical stroke, colour and weight; neither is shown as excluded, lesser or decided. No remoteness or scope doctrine, test, liability, amount, outcome or jurisdiction is stated. The relationships drawn are exactly those supplied, each with its kind; no preset supplies a causal link, so no causal arrow is drawn. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives and losses are editable, with the mechanism fields (elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels, traversalOrder); 'origin' is added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold' (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision, production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md)). True driver: the 1:1 box (each ring piece on its plinth must reach 0.20 of the frame height), and at 9:16 the relation label that must fit, on one line, between the two pieces. Fallbacks tried: record over the pieces with the boundary piece in the top band; pieces beside the record (row, rowcol); stack; stacked or side-by-side captions; text sizes down to 17 px. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy in production/scratch/causation-08/LAW-0710.stress-precap.json): full counts (six consequences, two accounts, one labelled link, two grouping items) → 1:1 fallback scale, pieces 0.094 of the frame height; four consequences → 0.111; three → 0.153; one account → 0.106; four consequences, one account, one grouping item, no link note → 1:1 0.203, 9:16 0.198 (relation label 'related in the supplied record', 30 characters, between the pieces); with the relation label 'related as it was supplied' (26 characters, baseline 19) and plinths 1.04× the piece width → 9:16 0.207. The stress therefore caps the COUNTS at four consequences (the first four), one account put forward (the first), one grouping item (the first) and no link note (baseline 3 / 0 / 1 / 0), and the plain-relation label at 26 characters; every text field stays strictly longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline.
